metadata.title: PAQ Product Launch OS
metadata.description: Turn product inputs into a reviewable, export-ready launch plan.

home.title: Upload product details. Get a complete AI-assisted launch plan.
home.subtitle: Bring positioning, audience insights, competitive differentiation, packaging direction, product-page copy, social posts, short-form video scripts, FAQs, and a first-month marketing plan into one reviewable report.
home.audience: Built for small brands, creative goods, tech accessories, lifestyle products, fragrance gifts, student ventures, and ecommerce sellers.
home.coreTitle: Turn product inputs into launch-ready decisions and content
home.feature1Text: Clarify the audience, pricing, channels, and launch angle in one practical positioning brief.
home.feature2Text: Prepare packaging direction, front and back copy, listing titles, and product descriptions.
home.feature3Text: Organize social posts, video scripts, FAQs, service responses, and a clear launch cadence.
home.outputsTitle: A launch report ready for meetings, review, editing, and pre-publish checks
home.outputsText: Each section can be copied into product pages, social content, packaging briefs, or internal documents.
home.demoTitle: Explore three complete demo launch plans
home.demoText: No form required. The examples cover creative goods, tech accessories, and home fragrance.

dashboard.title: Product Lifecycle Dashboard
dashboard.description: Review demo and locally created products. Data stays in this browser via localStorage.
dashboard.listText: Single-column on mobile, two columns on tablet, and three on desktop.
dashboard.emptyText: Create a product to see its status, creation time, and report entry point.
dashboard.demoText: Public demos default to Mock AI. Review regulations, trademarks, and asset rights before external use.

product.missing: This product is not available locally
product.missingText: localStorage may have been cleared. Return to Dashboard to view available products.

form.title: Create a product launch plan
form.description: Enter product details and the server-side workflow will generate a launch report.
form.dataText: One column on mobile and two columns when space allows.
form.name: Product name
form.featuresPlaceholder: Describe materials, functions, and use cases
form.audiencePlaceholder: Describe needs, context, age, and buying channels
form.channelsHint: Separate entries with commas or line breaks
form.reminder1: AI calls only run through the server-side API route.
form.reminder2: Without an API key, the workflow falls back to Mock Demo.
form.reminder3: Regulated categories still require human and legal review.

report.description: Copy, export, edit, and review every section before publishing.
report.translateText: Create a professional localized report for cross-border ecommerce and presentations.
report.notGeneratedText: Choose a target language and translate the report.
report.reviewFlow: Copy, Edit, Approve, and Reject support human review before publishing.
report.summaryText: Use this overview to align positioning, price, audience, and channels before reviewing the full plan.
report.legalIntro: Review each item before publishing; this does not imply the product is currently non-compliant.
report.legal1: AI-generated content requires human review and must not be published as an unsupported claim.
report.legal2: Confirm commercial rights for packaging, images, illustrations, fonts, music, and other assets.
report.legal3: Food, beauty, wellness, and medical products must not claim treatment, disease improvement, or guaranteed effects.
report.legal4: Check platform rules and applicable local regulations before listing.

lifecycle.title: Product lifecycle
lifecycle.scroll: Scroll horizontally to view the full lifecycle

auth.loginDescription: Sign in to sync products, reports, and autosaved drafts. Local demo still works without Supabase env.
auth.signupDescription: Create an email account to keep your product workspace and autosaved drafts.
auth.resetDescription: Enter your email and Supabase will send a reset link.
auth.missingConfig: Supabase env is not configured. The app is running in local demo mode.
auth.magicSent: Magic link sent. Check your inbox.
auth.resetSent: Reset email sent. Check your inbox.
auth.signupCheckEmail: Account created. Check your inbox to confirm your email.
auth.hasAccount: Already have an account? Log in

help.title: AI Help
help.subtitle: This assistant only answers questions about PAQ Product Launch OS features and services.
help.scopeNotice: Ask how to create products, generate reports, export files, recover drafts, or review data safety settings.
help.placeholder: Example: What export formats are available?
help.privacyNote: Full conversations are not stored long term.
help.rateLimited: AI Help has reached the current demo limit. Please try again later.
help.outOfScope: I can only help with PAQ Product Launch OS site features, product planning workflows, report exports, accounts, and data safety.
